description_en: Submits a basic voice cloning job

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier for the voice.
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for the voice
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.description_en:
The OSS URL where the demo audio will be saved.

- If specified, the service generates a demo audio file at the provided OSS URL after training completes.

- ><notice>

  The URL must be a valid public address for an OSS object in your account.

  ></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
示例音频输出地址  
- 如果传入此参数，则会在训练成功后在此参数表示的 OSS 地址生成示例音频  
- 如果不传入此参数，则不会生成示例音频
><notice>需要是您账号下合法的 OSS 公网地址></notice>
